channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: যাত্রাবাড়ীতে তরুণ মৃত্যুর ঘটনায় অস্ত্র কার চালিয়েছে তা অনিশ্চিত
item.description: গত মঙ্গলবার রাজধানীর ধলপুরে এসআরবির অভিযানের সময় গুলিবিদ্ধ হয়ে মারুফ ওরফে দুখু মিয়া নিহত হন। তবে কার গুলিতে তার মৃত্যু হয়েছে তা এখনও নিশ্চিত হওয়া যায়নি।

item.title: ਡਰਾਈਵਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡਾਟਾ ਵੇਚਣ ਦੇ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਵਿੱਚ GM ਦਾ ਸਮਝੌਤਾ
item.description: General Motors ਨੇ ਡਰਾਈਵਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵੇਚਣ ਦੇ ਦੋਸ਼ਾਂ ਤਹਿਤ 220 ਮਿਲੀਅਨ ਡਾਲਰ ਦਾ ਸਮਝੌਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤਹਿਤ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਨੂੰ ਡਰਾਈਵਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਲੈਣੀ ਪਵੇਗੀ।

item.title: নারীর ক্ষমতায়নে বড় বাধা ধর্ম ও পুরুষতন্ত্র: জহির উদ্দিন স্বপন
item.description: সেভ দ্য চিলড্রেন ইন বাংলাদেশ আয়োজিত কার্নিভ্যালে জহির উদ্দিন স্বপন মন্তব্য করেন যে, নারীর ক্ষমতায়নের পথে ভুল ধর্মীয় ব্যাখ্যা এবং পুরুষতান্ত্রিক মানসিকতা প্রধান চ্যালেঞ্জ।

item.title: ডিএসসিসি কর্মকর্তাদের মাসিক জ্বালানি কোটা হ্রাস করা হলো
item.description: প্রথম আলোর অনুসন্ধানে জানা গেছে, ঢাকা দক্ষিণ সিটি করপোরেশনের কর্মকর্তাদের জন্য প্রতি মাসে বরাদ্দকৃত জ্বালানির পরিমাণ কমানো হয়েছে। আগে এসব গাড়িতে মাসিক ৪০০ থেকে ৬০০ লিটার পর্যন্ত জ্বালানি দেওয়া হতো।

item.title: আইনমন্ত্রী জানিয়েছেন দেশে বিচারাধীন মামলার সংখ্যা ৪৬ লাখ ছাড়িয়েছে
item.description: আইনমন্ত্রী সংসদে জানান যে বর্তমানে দেশে ৪৬ লাখের বেশি মামলা অমীমাংসিত রয়েছে। তিনি আরও মন্তব্য করেন যে আরামপ্রদ চাকরি করতে চাওয়া বিচারকদের উপযুক্ত স্থানে বদলি করা হবে।

item.title: প্রতিরক্ষা খাত আরও জোরদার করার তাগিদ সংসদীয় কমিটির
item.description: দেশের প্রতিরক্ষাব্যবস্থা আরও সুদৃঢ় করার জন্য সুনির্দিষ্ট সুপারিশ পেশ করেছে সংসদীয় কমিটি। ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদের প্রতিরক্ষা মন্ত্রণালয় সম্পর্কিত স্থায়ী কমিটির দ্বিতীয় বৈঠকে এই আলোচনা হয়।

item.title: Spanish clubs observe silence for train crash victims
item.description: Real Madrid and FC Barcelona joined other Spanish football clubs in holding a moment of silence. This tribute was dedicated to those who lost their lives in Wednesday's train collision.

item.title: Archive of Our Own faces potential four-week outage
item.description: The widely used fan fiction platform Archive of Our Own has informed its users of a possible downtime lasting up to four weeks. This potential disruption concerns its global community of readers and writers.

item.title: West Bank Operations Leave Multiple Palestinians Hurt and Detained
item.description: Israeli security forces conducted operations throughout the West Bank resulting in injuries and arrests. Concurrently, ongoing military actions displaced over 3,300 residents in Hebron from their properties.

item.title: বাংলাদেশ এলডিসি উত্তরণের সময়সীমা তিন বছর বাড়াল
item.description: স্বল্পোন্নত দেশের তালিকা থেকে বাংলাদেশের বের হওয়ার সময়সীমা তিন বছর পিছিয়েছে। নির্ধারিত ২৪ নভেম্বর ২০২৬ এর পরিবর্তে এখন এটি ২০২৯ সালের নভেম্বরে নির্ধারিত হয়েছে, যা দেশকে বাড়তি প্রস্তুতি নেওয়ার সুযোগ দেবে।

item.title: Traffic Restrictions and Heavy Security Set for Diljit Dosanjh Delhi Show
item.description: The Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium expects roughly 70,000 attendees for the October 30 Diljit Dosanjh concert. Authorities implemented traffic regulations starting at 1 p.m., prohibited public parking nearby, deployed 2,000 private security personnel, and scheduled midnight Metro operations.

item.title: Putin Welcomes African Heads of State for Moscow Summit
item.description: Russian leader Vladimir Putin convened with various African officials during a diplomatic meeting in the capital of Russia. The discussions centered around the nature of bilateral relations between Moscow and the continent.

item.title: Supreme Court Questions RBI Regarding Digital Arrest Financial Losses
item.description: The Supreme Court issued a directive to the Reserve Bank of India concerning compensation for financial assets stolen through online fraud schemes known as digital arrests.

item.title: Central Bureau of Investigation Examines Overseas Money Received by Activist
item.description: Federal investigators are reviewing international financial transactions connected to an activist based in Arunachal Pradesh.

item.title: Delhi Police Enforce Road Closures Near JLN Stadium for October 30 Concert
item.description: Authorities announced traffic alterations across eleven thoroughfares from early afternoon until midnight for the Diljit Dosanjh event. Commuters were urged to utilize underground rail transit, while ticket holders received instructions regarding specific arrival corridors.

item.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
item.description: As reported by BBC World, The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan. Key points: Alaska, Democratic, The Republican, New York Times.

item.title: Israeli Election Ends Without Clear Parliamentary Majority
item.description: Final ballot counts confirm that no single political bloc achieved the 61-seat threshold required to govern. Consequently, opposition figures are now investigating potential alliances to establish a coalition government.

item.title: রূপপুর পারমাণবিক বিদ্যুৎকেন্দ্রের দ্বিতীয় ইউনিটের প্রথম জ্বালানি চালান পৌঁছাল
item.description: গত সোমবার ঢাকা পৌঁছানোর পর কঠোর নিরাপত্তার মধ্য দিয়ে মঙ্গলবার রূপপুর প্রকল্প এলাকায় দ্বিতীয় ইউনিটের প্রথম পারমাণবিক জ্বালানি পরিবহন করা হয়। সংশ্লিষ্ট প্রকল্প সূত্রে এই তথ্য নিশ্চিত করা হয়েছে।

item.title: Temporary Ceasefire Brings Brief Period of Calm to Kherson
item.description: A pause in hostilities has allowed residents of Kherson to experience a short interval of tranquility. Despite the current quiet, people living in the city remain concerned about the inevitable return of combat.

item.title: Possible New Dwarf Planet Identified Beyond Pluto's Orbit
item.description: Researchers using the Vera C. Rubin Observatory have located a luminous body that may qualify as the solar system’s sixth dwarf planet. The object follows an angled path around the sun at a distance further than Pluto.

item.title: Jody Cundy Loses Para-Cycling World Title After Two Decades
item.description: Australian cyclist Korey Boddington has defeated Jody Cundy in the C4 kilo time trial. This loss concludes Cundy’s twenty-year streak as the world champion in this specific para-cycling event.

item.title: Actor Sir Patrick Stewart Dies at Age 86 in Los Angeles
item.description: The British performer, famous for his roles in the X-Men and Star Trek series, passed away at home following a struggle with dementia. A statement from his family confirmed his death was linked to Alzheimer’s and Lewy body diseases.

item.title: Alexander Zverev to Claim Top Spot in World Tennis Rankings
item.description: By advancing to the quarter-finals of the tournament in Vienna, Alexander Zverev has secured the men's world number one ranking. He is set to overtake Jannik Sinner at the next opportunity for ranking updates.

item.title: রামপুরায় দুই বাসের রেষারেষিতে প্রাণ হারালেন এক ইলেকট্রিশিয়ান
item.description: গত বৃহস্পতিবার বিদেশ সফর শেষে দেশে ফেরার কিছুক্ষণ পর রামপুরায় দুই বাসের প্রতিযোগিতার মাঝে পড়ে এক বিদ্যুৎ মিস্ত্রি নিহত হয়েছেন। নিহতের স্বজনরা জানান, ওই ব্যক্তি চীন থেকে ফিরে আসার দিন সকালেই এই দুর্ঘটনার শিকার হন।

item.title: UN Announces 2026 Recipients of the SDG Action Awards
item.description: The United Nations has announced the honorees for its 2026 SDG Action Awards. The recognition highlights initiatives supporting indigenous women in Guatemala, female education in India, and land rehabilitation in Mali.

item.title: Berlin Politician Elif Eralp Faces Criticism Over Interview
item.description: Left-wing politician Elif Eralp is facing backlash following a Der Spiegel interview. The article stated she avoided naming a pro-Palestinian activist to protect her relatives from potential retaliation.

item.title: Renowned Shakespearean and Sci-Fi Actor Patrick Stewart Passes Away at 86
item.description: Actor Patrick Stewart has died at the age of 86. He began his acting career at 18 and built a celebrated theatrical reputation with the Royal Shakespeare Company during the 1960s before starring in major franchises.

item.title: Justin and Hailey Bieber Purchase $12 Million New York Apartment
item.description: Justin and Hailey Bieber bought a $12 million condominium in Manhattan's West Village. The four-bedroom property offers river views, extensive window space, and private amenities.

item.title: Canada Turns Toward Europe Amid US Trade Tensions Under Trump
item.description: Canada is engaging with European partners as trade conflicts driven by Donald Trump push the country away from the United States and toward the EU.

item.title: Reddit Modifies Platform Strategy Amid Declining Search Engine Traffic
item.description: Reddit is pivoting toward a logged-in user experience. This strategic shift comes as artificial intelligence alters traditional online information discovery and search traffic declines.

item.title: Madras High Court Questions Officials on Bar Sales Near Schools
item.description: The Madras High Court asked the Prohibition and Excise Commissioner if there are proposals to limit alcohol sales at venues near schools. Justice N. Ramesh raised the inquiry after a 19-year-old student drank at a bar linked to his college.

item.title: West Valley Muslim Association Buys $16.5M Cupertino Property
item.description: The West Valley Muslim Association bought a property in Cupertino for $16.5 million following a two-decade search. The new site will host daily prayers and educational programs for the local community.

item.title: Rivian and Volkswagen broaden partnership to cover AI assistants
item.description: The collaborative venture between Rivian and VW now incorporates artificial intelligence technology. Management has not specified whether this update alters the total $5.8 billion financial commitment.

item.title: Rivian posts better-than-expected Q3 results on software and R2 growth
item.description: Stronger software sales and increased R2 shipments helped Rivian surpass third-quarter analyst projections. The company additionally updated its 2026 outlook for spending, earnings, and deliveries.

item.title: X-Men and Star Trek actor Patrick Stewart dies at 86
item.description: Renowned actor Patrick Stewart has passed away at his Los Angeles residence at the age of 86. His relatives confirmed that he died following a short battle with Alzheimer's disease.

item.title: French authorities say suspect targeted Muslims and North Africans
item.description: According to French prosecutor Olivier Christen, the accused confessed to selecting the site because he believed it was heavily frequented by Islamists.

item.title: Reddit mandates user sign-ins amid declining search traffic from AI
item.description: To combat drops in search visibility caused by artificial intelligence, Reddit is beginning international trials that require account logins.

item.title: Actor Patrick Stewart passes away at 86 in Los Angeles
item.description: Patrick Stewart, famed for his performances in Star Trek and X-Men, died at his home on Wednesday. A statement shared via his Instagram account noted he passed away following a brief illness with Alzheimer's disease.

item.title: Veteran stage and screen actor Patrick Stewart remembered
item.description: The English performer initially established his acting background in theater before achieving global recognition as the commander of the USS Enterprise.

item.title: Rivian upgrades annual forecast as R2 SUV drives strong demand
item.description: High consumer demand for the new R2 electric vehicle prompted Rivian to raise its financial projections for the second time within the year.

item.title: Reddit plans mandatory user sign-in for site access
item.description: Reddit is preparing to mandate user authentication to view its platform. Previously, visitors could access crowdsourced content across various topics without needing an account.

item.title: Starbucks reports mixed sales results with strong US growth
item.description: Domestic same-store metrics for Starbucks exceeded analyst forecasts. However, international market performance missed broader financial expectations.

item.title: Iraqi court sentences three French IS suspects to life in prison
item.description: Three French citizens moved from Syrian detention facilities have been given life sentences. They are among dozens of French nationals accused of joining the Islamic State.

item.title: Google resolves Google Photos bug affecting edited picture visibility
item.description: A software issue that prevented edited pictures within Google Photos from appearing in third-party applications has been fixed by Google.

item.title: Windows 11 update introduces context menu updates and cloud recovery
item.description: Microsoft has released a software update for Windows 11 featuring context menu enhancements. The patch also adds a cloud-based recovery tool for non-booting computers.

item.title: Thrive Holdings to buy ADT for 15.3 billion dollars with AI focus
item.description: The OpenAI-supported firm Thrive Holdings is purchasing ADT in a transaction valued at 15.3 billion dollars. The acquisition aims to integrate artificial intelligence into home security services.

item.title: Rivian R2 becomes top-selling model in Q3 2026 financial report
item.description: Rivian released its financial data for the third quarter of 2026. The R2 electric vehicle has become the company's highest-selling model for the first time during production scaling.

item.title: Inglis scores second Test century after replacing Steven Smith
item.description: After stepping in as a late replacement for Steven Smith, Inglis scored his second Test century. This performance presents selectors with new strategic decisions.

item.title: Chambal firearm culture probed in cheetah shooting case
item.description: Madhya Pradesh wildlife authorities have highlighted local gun traditions as a key focus in the ongoing investigation into the shooting of a cheetah. Officials have already discussed this aspect with high-ranking police leadership.

item.title: Google expands artificial intelligence ads to new regions
item.description: Google is rolling out sponsored content within its AI feature to additional international territories. This expansion aims to enhance the commercial viability of the tool through increased monetization.

item.title: Pentagon watchdog declines Starlink Ukraine speed probe
item.description: The Pentagon inspector general has turned down a bipartisan inquiry request from U.S. senators regarding reported Starlink and Starshield service disruptions in Ukraine.

item.title: Norwegian stock climbs 13 percent following strong earnings
item.description: Norwegian shares jumped significantly after the firm exceeded profit expectations and increased its financial outlook. The company noted that reservation numbers have increased slightly, though they stay under ideal levels.

item.title: West Bengal threatens penalties for Diwali firecracker breaches
item.description: West Bengal authorities have announced stringent penalties for breaking firecracker regulations during Diwali and Chhath festivals. The state police chief stated that releasing sky lanterns is strictly prohibited without prior fire department approval.

item.title: Former air force official Towsif dies under unclear circumstances
item.description: Former flight lieutenant Towsif Sauri has died under mysterious conditions. He had previously been dismissed from his position in the air force on September 1, 2024.

item.title: Afghanistan defeats Zimbabwe after Omarzai century
item.description: Afghanistan secured a series victory against Zimbabwe following a century by Omarzai. After sliding to four runs for five wickets, the team recovered to reach 221, securing their third-highest T20I total.

item.title: Renowned actor Patrick Stewart passes away at 86
item.description: British actor Patrick Stewart, famous for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, has passed away at the age of 86. A statement issued on Thursday confirmed the death of the celebrated performer, who also had a distinguished theater background.

item.title: সিসিটিভি ফুটেজে নিখোঁজ তাহসিফ
item.description: নিখোঁজ হওয়ার আগে বিমানবাহিনীর সাবেক কর্মকর্তা তাহসিফ সাউরি এক পরিচিত যুবকের সঙ্গে খাবার হোটেলে যান। নিরাপত্তা ক্যামেরার ফুটেজে এই দৃশ্য ধরা পড়েছে।

item.title: Cornell University holds confidence vote on president
item.description: Faculty members are casting ballots regarding the administration's management of a reported gang assault. The voting process runs through next Friday.

item.title: NHRC probes public parading of three individuals
item.description: The rights panel initiated an inquiry into the incident in southern Kolkata following media coverage. It noted that the event points to potential rights violations.

item.title: Trump declines to back candidate in Brazil vote
item.description: Donald Trump stated he remains neutral on the Brazilian election while criticizing the process. His remarks followed his ally Flavio Bolsonaro relocating to Miami.
